tagline: Your mail, on your own infrastructure
brief: A native Android and iOS mail client for a self-hosted Agentic Inbox backend. Mail, credentials and cache stay between the device and the user's own Cloudflare account. The identity is the Airmail system: navy ink, the red and navy band, the postmark.
criteria: Success: unlike any other mail app mark, recognisable at 16 px, works in one colour, and reads as the same family as the in-app Airmail band.

concepts.name: Airmail Envelope
concepts.idea: The airmail-border envelope: each conversation is a letter, and the stripes are the app's own band.
rationale: Navy and red airmail stripes are unclaimed in the mail category
Same navy, red and 45 degree stripe as the in-app AirmailBand
Holds up in one colour and reversed; a bolder small-size cut covers 16 to 24 px

recommendation: Airmail Envelope: ownable, built from the app's own design system, and complete with small-size, dark-mode and launcher versions.
